description: Optimize the student, teacher, and admin portals for strict access isolation, a stable student analysis flow, trusted history playback, and real management operations.

userStories.title: Role route guard matrix
userStories.description: As a logged-in user, I want each role to reach only its own protected portal so that I do not see pages for the wrong identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated access to the student, teacher, and admin protected routes redirects to the login page

A teacher account is redirected away from student and admin protected routes with a visible notice

A student request for another student's resource returns a clear unauthorized response instead of resource data
